messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will create a long weekend by adding the nearest weekend days):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | Jan 1–2 (New Year’s Eve & New Year’s Day) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | Feb 18–20 (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | Apr 7–9 (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | May 20–22 (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | Jul 1–3 (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | Sep 2–4 (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | Oct 7–9 (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Remembrance Day (observed) | Nov 11 (Monday) | Monday | Nov 9–11 (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | Dec 23–25 (Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | Dec 26–28 (Tuesday‑Wednesday‑Thursday) |

**Notes**

* Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, National Indigenous Peoples Day in British Columbia).  
* If a holiday falls on a weekend, the federal government typically observes it on the following Monday (unless the holiday itself is on a weekend, as shown above).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like province‑specific long weekends or a different format!
